summary: Nintendo's racing-first snowboarding series; use Nintendo Classics for the original and GameCube/Dolphin for Avalanche.

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics N64 app / local N64 emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use official Nintendo Classics route first.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official Nintendo Classics emulation or high-resolution local N64 emulation

primary.why: The N64 original was re-released on Wii, Wii U, and Nintendo Classics; the current Nintendo Classics route is the best official modern access path.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack's Nintendo 64 app; use original N64 hardware or local N64 emulation only for comparison.

emulation.notes: Use Dolphin for higher output resolution or original GameCube hardware for native behavior.

primary.why: Avalanche is a GameCube-only sequel with 480p and Dolby Pro Logic II support; Dolphin can improve output resolution while preserving the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Play on GameCube hardware with 480p-capable setup or Dolphin with internal-resolution scaling.
